summary: John's 2nd cousin 4x removed (granddaughter of Richard Heffernan and Anastasia Boney); wife of a Leadville mine owner shot in 1880.
bio: Anna S. Heffernan (1859-1914) married Richard Dillon (1850-1927), 'former owner of the Little Chief mine', who was shot by a faro dealer at Leadville, Colorado, in July 1880. He survived: 'Dick is shot; getting along well. Annie Dillon.' He died at Globe, Arizona, in 1927.
sources: Michael Dwyer, Heffernans of Slieveardagh (Welsh Hill Press, 2020), Branch 4 (and Branch 3), working from the Killenaule and Gortnahoe Catholic parish registers: https://archive.org/details/heffernans-of-slieveardagh (quoting The Sun (NY) 29 Jul 1880 and the Wilkes-Barre Record of the Times 30 Jul 1880)
